problem: people who hold an intent lose what they meant when it is translated through analysts, specs and developers before it reaches software
why: so software does what people meant, without depending on a developer to translate
outcomes: a person turns their own rough words into a drawing a factory can build to
every difference between readings becomes a question the person answers in a few taps
the person can leave and come back to the work
a released package the factory consumes

people.name: the factory that builds to the drawing

measures.text: a first-time person goes from rough words to a released drawing without help

constraints: never guess where two readings differ
